name: O'Hare Precision
verdict: O'Hare Precision's paid channels (Meta and Google Ads) show zero spend, leads, and clicks over the past 28 days, suggesting campaigns are paused or inactive. The biggest movement is a 75% drop in GBP actions week-over-week, likely driven by reduced organic search visibility or a lull in local demand, though the profile still generated 138 total actions including 10 calls and 86 direction requests in the 28-day window.

performance.verdict: Paid channels dead; GBP fading; 6 SOW milestones overdue and blocking pipeline.

findings.text: 4 CRM milestones overdue (oldest July 7): 342 stub reconciliation (blocker, Aug 31) and Tom call list (Jul 28) not closed; Sugar pipeline integrity at risk.
Web/SEO blocker (root cause + fix, due Aug 31) and Outreach contacts pull for AGS + Forte (due Aug 31) both overdue — downstream work is gated.
Zero paid spend and zero leads for all 28 days of the window; Meta and Google Ads are fully paused — no CPL is possible while both channels are dark.
GBP actions dropped 75% week-over-week; last 3 days (Sep 7–9) show 0, 0, 0 vs prior 3-day avg of ~6 — a confirmed 3-day signal, not a single-day blip.
Search Console clicks fell 26.92% week-over-week; Sep 9 reads 0 — last 3 days avg 8.7 vs prior 3-day avg of 15.7, confirming organic search is weakening in tandem with GBP.

suggestions.text: Escalate 342 stub reconciliation and Tom call list to Ahmed immediately — both are confirmed blockers gating Sales-i sync.

suggestions.text: Watch GBP actions and SC clicks for 3 more days — if both remain at 0, escalate to SEO review; do not act on paid channels until reactivation is confirmed.
